description: This Java class 'SpeedCalculator' provides utility methods to calculate vehicle speed in mph and kph based on RPM and gear ratio, as well as calculating RPM from vehicle speed, ratio, and units. It is part of the 'com.romraider.logger.car.util' package and relies on constants defined elsewhere.

classes.name: SpeedCalculator
classes.description: Utility class for calculating vehicle speed and RPM conversions based on RPM, gear ratio, and units.

methods.name: calculateMph
methods.description: Calculates speed in miles per hour (mph) given RPM and gear ratio.

methods.name: calculateKph
methods.description: Calculates speed in kilometers per hour (kph) given RPM and gear ratio.

methods.name: calculateRpm
methods.description: Calculates RPM based on vehicle speed, gear ratio, and specified units (imperial or metric).
